title: Elastic Launch
description: Stretch the dot forward like a spring and release a rapid thrust to clear moving wall gaps. Survive as long as you can.
controls: Space or click to stretch and launch
Press R or click Restart to restart

title: Wall Bounce
description: A dot auto‑advances; each tap flips its vertical direction and adds an upward boost, letting you ricochet around obstacles with static gaps.
controls: Tap / Click / Touch to bounce
Press R or click Restart to restart

title: Phase Toggle
description: Tap to switch the dot between solid and intangible states; solid collides with obstacles, intangible passes through them but cannot collect points, requiring precise timing to thread through alternating barriers.
controls: Space to toggle solid/intangible
Arrow Up/Down to move
Press R or click Restart

title: Pulse Repel
description: The dot moves forward automatically; tap to emit a radial pulse that temporarily pushes nearby obstacles outward, clearing a path before the pulse fades.
controls: Tap / click to emit pulse
Press R or click Restart

title: Magnet Polarity Switch
description: Tap to flip polarity and steer a constantly moving dot through metal obstacles. Attract or repel to survive.
controls: Space or click to toggle polarity
Press R or click Restart

title: Chromatic Shift
description: A dot auto‑advances through a colored tunnel. Tap to cycle its hue and only pass through segments that match the current color. Time your changes to survive as long as possible.
controls: Click/Tap to cycle color
Press R or click Restart to reset

title: Mirror Flip
description: A dot moves forward automatically; each tap mirrors its horizontal position across the center line to dodge obstacles that appear on one side of the tunnel.
controls: Tap or click to mirror position
Press R or click Restart to reset

title: Speed Switch
description: Toggle the dot's speed to match gate requirements and survive as long as possible.
controls: Space bar or mouse click to toggle speed
Press R or click Restart to restart the game

title: Rail Rider
description: A dot auto‑clings to a moving rail that snakes across the screen; each tap jumps the dot to an adjacent parallel rail, letting you hop between rails to avoid gaps that appear in each path.
controls: Tap or click to switch rails
Press R or click Restart to reset

title: Tether Swing
description: A dot auto‑advances; tap to fire a temporary tether to a fixed point ahead, swing around it and launch over obstacles, then release to detach and continue forward.
controls: Tap / Click to fire or release tether
Press R or click Restart to reset

title: Wall Stick
description: A dot moves forward automatically; tap to cling to the nearest wall, slide vertically, and avoid gaps and hazards.
controls: Tap / Click to cling to a wall
Arrow keys to move while clinging
Press R or click Restart to reset

title: Mass Shift
description: The dot auto‑advances; each tap adds mass making it larger and able to smash through breakable walls, while holding releases mass to shrink for tight gaps, forcing you to balance power and size.
controls: Click to grow
Hold click to shrink
Press R or click Restart to reset

title: Pressure Pulse
description: A dot auto‑advances; each tap pressurizes it, letting it crush soft barriers while pressure drains and speed drops. Time your presses to break through obstacles.
controls: Tap / Click or press Space to pressurize
Press R or click Restart to reset

title: Layer Shift
description: Swap between two invisible layers to avoid incoming obstacle gaps. The dot auto‑advances as the track scrolls, requiring precise timing to survive.
controls: Space or mouse click to toggle layer
Press R or click Restart to reset the game

title: Scale Shift
description: A dot auto‑advances; each tap cycles its overall size (small, medium, large) so you can slip through gaps sized for that scale, rewarding precise timing.
controls: Tap or press Space to cycle size
Press R or click Restart to reset the game

title: Gravity Flip
description: Flip gravity to ride the ceiling and thread through alternating gaps.
controls: Tap / Click / Space to flip gravity
Press R or click Restart to reset

title: Curvature Control
description: A dot auto‑advances forward; each tap toggles a gentle left‑or‑right curvature, letting you steer through winding tunnels without changing speed.
controls: Tap or click to toggle curvature
Press R or click Restart to restart

title: Momentum Swap
description: Tap to swap the dot's velocity with the nearest moving block, riding it through passages while the dot auto‑advances. Survive as long as possible.
controls: Tap / click to swap velocity with nearest block
Press R or click Restart to reset

title: Echo Trail
description: A dot leaves a fading clone trail that mirrors its past positions; tap to temporarily reverse time, causing the leading dot to follow the oldest clone while the trail rewinds, letting you dodge incoming obstacles.
controls: Tap / click to reverse time
Press R or click Restart to restart

title: Pulse Flip
description: A dot rolls along a straight path while the corridor walls pulse between thick and thin. Tap to invert the pulse phase, opening gaps for the dot to slip through.
controls: Tap / click to invert pulse phase
Press R or click Restart button to reset

title: Pulse Leap
description: A dot auto‑scrolls along a sine wave. Tap or click to launch it in a high arc that skips a segment of the wave, letting you clear tight gaps before landing back on the path.
controls: Tap or click to launch
Press R or click Restart

title: Pulse Warp
description: A dot moves forward at constant speed while the background grid pulses in and out; tapping toggles a temporal warp that speeds up the grid while the dot keeps its pace, letting it slip through temporarily widened gaps.
controls: Tap or click to toggle warp
Press R or click Restart to reset

title: Spiral Ascent
description: A dot drifts outward while rotating around the canvas center; each tap rotates its angle to thread through gaps in rotating concentric rings.
controls: Tap / click to rotate
Press R or click Restart

title: Orbit Flip
description: A dot orbits a fixed center while expanding radial rings with gaps; tap or press Space to flip direction and slip through the gaps. Survive as long as possible.
controls: Space or mouse click to flip direction
Press R or click Restart to reset

title: Pulse Inverter
description: Tap to invert the pulse phase of the corridor walls, letting a moving dot slip through the expanding and contracting gaps. Survive as long as possible while the walls rhythmically change shape.
controls: Tap / Click to invert pulse phase
Press R or click Restart to reset the game

title: Vertical Shift
description: A dot rides a sine wave that shifts up or down with taps, aligning with high or low gaps in scrolling obstacles.
controls: Space or click to raise baseline (release to lower)
Press R or click Restart to restart

title: Radius Shift
description: Orbit a moving anchor while expanding or contracting your radius to slip through rotating gate openings. Survive as long as possible and rack up points for each gate passed.
controls: Space or tap to change orbit radius
Press R or click Restart to reset

title: Trail Fade
description: A dot continuously moves forward, leaving a solid trail. Tap or click to temporarily erase the trail, letting the dot slip through its own line.
controls: Tap or click to erase trail
Press R or click Restart to reset

title: Teleport Dash
description: An arcade game where an auto‑advancing dot moves forward and you tap, click, or press Space to instantly teleport it ahead, jumping over incoming barriers. A short cooldown prevents spamming. Survive as long as possible.
controls: Tap / Click / Space to teleport
Press R or click Restart to reset

title: Axis Twist
description: Rotate the dot into a short line segment by tapping, letting it slip through angled slits. Release to restore the circle and navigate the arena.
controls: Tap or click to rotate (and score)
Press R or click Restart to reset

title: Chrono Pulse
description: A dot auto‑advances while obstacles scroll. Briefly tap to freeze obstacle motion while the dot keeps moving, letting you slip through tight gaps. Timing the freeze determines how far you get before obstacles resume.
controls: Tap / click to freeze obstacles (hold briefly)
Press R or click Restart to restart

title: Lane Shift
description: A dot auto‑scrolls forward while three parallel lanes scroll past. Tap or press Space to cycle the dot to the next lane and thread through each lane’s moving gaps. Survive as long as possible and earn points for every safe pass.
controls: Tap or press Space to change lane
Press R or click Restart to restart

title: Charge Dash
description: Hold to charge a high‑speed dash that lets you thread through fleeting gaps as the dot moves forward.
controls: Hold Space to charge, release to dash
Press R or click Restart to restart

title: Phase Ripple
description: A dot moves forward automatically; tap or press Space to toggle its phase between two sinusoidal waveforms, each allowing passage through a distinct set of oscillating barriers while blocking the other.
controls: Tap or press Space to toggle phase
Press R or click Restart to reset

title: Dual Pulse
description: Tap to split a dot into two synchronized copies that travel opposite directions. Steer both through mirrored gaps, losing if either collides.
controls: Space to split
Arrow keys to steer
Press R or click Restart

title: Elastic Pulse
description: Tap to stretch the dot horizontally, allowing it to slip through narrow vertical gaps; release to snap back and avoid colliding with side walls.
controls: Hold mouse button (or Space) to stretch
Release to snap back
Press R to restart

title: Magnet Pulse
description: Tap to flip the ball’s magnetic polarity, causing it to be attracted to blue plates and repelled by orange plates. Ride the moving plates, avoid spikes, and survive as long as you can.
controls: Click or press Space to toggle polarity
Press R to restart

title: Momentum Slider
description: Tap to reverse the ball's horizontal velocity while it slides along a narrow corridor; time the reversals to weave through moving vertical barriers that appear in sync with the ball's speed.
controls: Tap / click to reverse direction
R to restart the game

title: Color Switch
description: Tap to change the dot’s hue while colored barriers scroll toward it. Align the dot’s color with each barrier’s matching opening to survive as long as possible.
controls: Click or tap to change dot color
R key to restart

title: Spin Tunnel
description: Control a dot sliding through a rotating tunnel; tap to reverse the spin and line up gaps as they approach. Survive as long as possible and try to beat your high score.
controls: Tap / click to reverse spin
Press R to restart

title: Shape Shift
description: Tap to toggle the player between a square and a circle, each passing through differently shaped gaps; survive as obstacles scroll by by matching your form to the opening.
controls: Tap to toggle shape
R to restart

title: Shadow Switch
description: Tap to toggle between parallel light and shadow layers, each with its own moving barriers. Keep the single dot safe by timing your switches so it never collides in either world.
controls: Tap / click to toggle layers
R to restart after game over

title: Ring Collapse
description: Concentric rings continuously shrink; tap the rotating outer marker to pause its spin and line up with gaps in the inner ring before the next collapse.
controls: Click to pause when marker aligns with inner gap
Press R to restart after game over

title: Mirror Slide
description: A line of light bounces between two walls; tap to reflect it horizontally or vertically, timing reflections to navigate through moving obstacles that appear only on one side.
controls: Click or tap to reflect the light

title: Vector Burst
description: A rotating laser beam shoots outward from the center; tap to change its rotation speed and angle, timing bursts to carve safe corridors through incoming geometric walls.
controls: Tap / Click to change laser direction and speed

title: Pulse Runner
description: Navigate a constantly advancing dot through moving gaps by shrinking or growing its size. Each successful passage extends the timer and speeds up the game.
controls: Arrow Up to grow the dot
Arrow Down to shrink the dot

title: Orbit Dodge
description: Orbit around a planet while dodging incoming asteroids on multiple lanes and collecting fuel orbs to extend your time.
controls: Arrow keys to rotate
Space to boost

title: Gravity Flip
description: Control a ball that flips gravity left or right to roll through a side‑scrolling corridor, collecting tokens while avoiding spikes.
controls: Arrow Left to flip gravity left
Arrow Right to flip gravity right
